import ctypes
from ctypes import c_uint, c_double
import os

def load_gsl():
    # Load the required GSL libraries in the correct order
    ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
    gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")
    return gsl

def gsl_cdf_binomial_P(k, p, n):
    # Validate input parameters
    if not (0 <= p <= 1):
        raise ValueError("Probability p must be between 0 and 1.")

    # Load the GSL library
    gsl = load_gsl()

    # Define the argument and return types for the gsl_cdf_binomial_P function
    gsl.gsl_cdf_binomial_P.argtypes = [c_uint, c_double, c_uint]
    gsl.gsl_cdf_binomial_P.restype = c_double

    # Call the function and return the result
    return gsl.gsl_cdf_binomial_P(k, p, n)

def assert_test():
    # Test cases for gsl_cdf_binomial_P

    # Test 1: Basic case
    result = gsl_cdf_binomial_P(3, 0.5, 5)
    expected = 0.8125  # Precomputed value
    assert abs(result - expected) < 1e-6, f"Test 1 failed: {result} != {expected}"

    # Test 2: Edge case where k = 0
    result = gsl_cdf_binomial_P(0, 0.5, 5)
    expected = 0.03125  # Precomputed value
    assert abs(result - expected) < 1e-6, f"Test 2 failed: {result} != {expected}"

    # Test 3: Edge case where k = n
    result = gsl_cdf_binomial_P(5, 0.5, 5)
    expected = 1.0  # Precomputed value
    assert abs(result - expected) < 1e-6, f"Test 3 failed: {result} != {expected}"

    # Test 4: Invalid probability p < 0
    try:
        gsl_cdf_binomial_P(3, -0.1, 5)
        assert False, "Test 4 failed: Exception not raised for p < 0"
    except ValueError:
        pass

    # Test 5: Invalid probability p > 1
    try:
        gsl_cdf_binomial_P(3, 1.1, 5)
        assert False, "Test 5 failed: Exception not raised for p > 1"
    except ValueError:
        pass

    print("All tests passed.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
